turns.input: Brother Aven gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Brother Aven reaches down and lifts a worn pair of leather boots from beside him, holding them out with both hands. "These came to the chapel," he says, his voice carrying that dry, patient tone that seems to have settled into him through years of unwanted gifts and necessary redistributions. "Clean, decent condition. Too large for most who pass through. You look a man who could fill them."

He does not press them forward insistently, merely presents them—an offering without ceremony, the sort of practical charity that fills his days. His tired eyes stay on Nicco's face, reading what reaction he might find there, prepared to withdraw or press on with equal calm.

The boots pass from his hands to Nicco's without further remark.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Nicco murmured thanks and held the boots out, returning them. "You'll need them more than me."

Brother Aven accepted the boots back without protest, though his tired face showed mild surprise. He tucked them under one arm, leather soles knocking gently against his hip. "We see who we see," he said. "The offer stands if you change your mind, or if you know someone who could use them." He glanced past Nicco toward the square's moderate traffic, then back, patient, waiting to see if anything else brought the tall man to him.
